Prohibition Act, On The File Of X Acmm, Mayo Hall,
Bangalore By Allowing This Petition.
 This Petition, Coming On For Admission, This Day,
The Court Made The Following:
 Order

The captioned petition is filed by husband seeking quashing of charge sheet filed in Crime No.389/2015 for the offence punishable under Section 498A of IPC read with Sections 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961.

2 . The petitioner while seeking quashing of the proceedings has placed on record memorandum of settlement entered into between the petitioner/husband and the respondent No.2/wife in Crl.Misc.No.168/2015.

Under the memorandum of settlement, the petitioner and respondent No.2 have arrived at an agreement that they will dissolve the marriage by mutual consent by filing a separate petition under Section 13(b).
The NC: 2023:KHC:19849 petitioner/husband has agreed to pay Rs.6,00,000/- to the respondent No.2/wife towards full and final settlement.

The respondent No.2/wife has also given an undertaking that she will fully co-operate with the petitioner/husband to get the criminal proceedings pending in Crl.Misc.No.168/2015 quashed at the appropriate forum.

3. In the light of memorandum of settlement entered into between the petitioner/husband and respondent No.2/wife, I am of the view that the charge sheet pending in Crime No.389/2015 is liable to be quashed.
Though the offences are found to be non- compoundable, however, they are found to be private in nature and do not have a serious impact on Society.
If there is an amicable settlement between petitioner/husband and respondent No.2/wife, I am of the view that the petitioner/husband is entitled for relief at the hands of this Court.

This Court is also of the view that petitioner in the light of amicable settlement cannot be NC: 2023:KHC:19849 subjected to criminal trial which, in all probability, amounts to abuse of process.
4.

For the reasons stated supra, I pass the following:
ORDER (i) The criminal petition is allowed;

(ii) The charge sheet pending in Crime No.389/2015 on the file of X ACMM,
Mayohall, Bengaluru City is quashed;
